name: Sharifa
source:
Sharifa is the Captain of Queen Merneith's personal guard and was the last Captain to serve the previous Queen in that capacity. She must be formidable fighter, because she can't have won the position with  her personality.

She is a tall woman with an imposing physique, lean and muscular. Just by looking at her body and the confident style of her command, it is easy to see that she has earned her position and most likely fought hard for it.
